subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app stay Overview-first with focused chat/media PR slices, adopt an explicit chat-first mode or default, or leave chat-first Android forks external while collecting ideas in the mobile RFC?
rationale: Current main has partial implementation and a broader RFC venue, but changing the official Android default or accepting fork-derived media/navigation slices affects onboarding, pairing, permissions, release posture, and Android product direction.

options.title: Route Broad Design To RFC And Scope Focused PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open as Android-specific context while owners ask contributors to move broad design comments to https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/28 and submit narrow proof-backed Android PR slices.

options.title: Sponsor Chat-First Android Mode
options.body: Explicitly approve a chat-first default or mode and require focused PRs with real-device onboarding, pairing, media, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Decline Official Chat-First Shift For Now
options.body: Close this after explaining that chat-first forks can remain external and only specific defects or small Android polish PRs should be filed in this repository.

recommendation.title: Route Broad Design To RFC And Scope Focused PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as Android-specific context while owners ask contributors to move broad design comments to https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/28 and submit narrow proof-backed Android PR slices.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily Android app product scope, and @obviyus is the listed Android app maintainer with relevant merged app-shell and chat-entry history.
